regions.why: "Main green: 1 a draft, its review first, 1 a draft, waiting on your word" is "Breaks a rule today", and its two region states would show "Works today"

classes.end: Main green: 2 a draft, waiting on your word
classes.rule: "Work never stops flowing: once nothing more happens on its own and main is green, it settles merged or waiting on your word."
classes.cause: a draft that touches a path that needs you is held before jmerge marks it ready, and jmerge --accept refuses a draft, so your word cannot move it

classes.end: Main red from a merge, its run rerun, machine full: 1 merged, 1 waiting to launch
classes.cause: its check missed a test that reads the changed path past what the selector sees, so a change that breaks that test merges

classes.end: Main red from outside: 1 a draft, waiting on your word, 1 a draft, waiting on your word, holds main's fix
classes.rule: "While main is red and nothing else can happen, its fix waits only on your approval, or on your word for its pull request." Since #547 jbus approves both fix rows it files, main's and the browser run's, by rule, so no approval of a fix row is yours: of the rule's waits, only your word is still yours, the go of a row you held or whose brief changed (Approve) and the lift of a pull request's hold (Accept).
classes.cause: main's fix row closed with its fix in an open draft, which jmerge never marks ready while it waits on your word, and jmerge --accept refuses a draft

classes.cause: main's fix row closed with its fix in an open pull request that waits on another, which cannot move

classes.cause: the pull request that holds main's fix broke a test of its own, and its crew reads that failure as main's red, which only its merge ends
